title: Debouncing
hints: Every Trigger starts a brand-new timer, so f runs once per trigger. A debouncer needs one timer that each trigger pushes back.
Create the timer once (in NewDebouncer) and stop it straight away. Trigger then calls Reset(d) on it, which reschedules a pending call.
func NewDebouncer(d time.Duration, f func()) *Debouncer { t := time.AfterFunc(d, f); t.Stop(); return &Debouncer{d: d, t: t} } — and Trigger: db.t.Reset(db.d)
